title: P1: -c before the subcommand is broken again (set_defaults channel=None in reputation parser)
desc: MAIN IS RED. Repro: 'chatcode -c dev say hi' lands in bus/general.jsonl again. Culprit: 1eeb492 (PR #29, reputation command) adds s.set_defaults(func=cmd_reputation, channel=None) - the exact shared-action poisoning that #35 (af9a5e4f) fixed for nine subparsers. tests/test_channel_flag_position.py catches it (1 case fails on current main). Fix: drop channel=None from that set_defaults; then both flag positions land in dev again.
